entries.brief: Original SKAZ D&D2014 fantasy reference-book spell illustration. Mature painterly realism, restrained natural colors, strong compact silhouette readable at32px on both dark navy and cream backgrounds, generous transparent margins. Single centered motif, no text, no UI, no border, no cartoon, no noisy scene. A broad golden wave branching from one glowing open hand to three upright restored adventurer bust silhouettes, balanced triangular grouping. Warm healing light and solid outlined figures, no cross UI.
